#### Description

The Polish Stempel analyzer is unable to load trie data from files, causing initialization failures. When attempting to use the Polish language analyzer, the trie loading process returns errors even when the data file is valid and readable.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```go
package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "github.com/blevesearch/bleve/v2/analysis/lang/pl/stempel"
)

    trie, err := stempel.LoadTrie()
    if err != nil {
        fmt.Printf("Error loading trie: %v\n", err)
        return
    }
    fmt.Printf("Successfully loaded trie: %v\n", trie)
}
```

Expected: Trie loads successfully without errors
Actual: Returns error even with valid trie data files

The issue appears to affect both multi-trie and single trie loading paths in the Polish stemmer functionality.

	rv = &trie{}
	rv.forward, err = r.ReadBool()
	if err != nil {

		if nerr != nil {

		}
		rv.cmds = append(rv.cmds, utfCommand)
		nCommands--

	nRows, err := r.ReadInt32()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("error reading trie num rows: %v", err)
	}
	for nRows > 0 {
		row, err := newRow(r)
		if err != nil {

		}

		nRows--
	}

	var rv []rune
	lastKey := key
	p := make([][]rune, len(t.tries))
	lastR := ' '
	for i := 0; i < len(t.tries); i++ {
		r := t.tries[i].GetLastOnPath(lastKey)
		if len(r) == 0 || len(r) == 1 && r[0] == eom {
